jobs.occupation: Mechanical Engineer – Product Documentation & Production Readiness
jobs.description:
At Weibel, you will join a truly technology-driven company delivering advanced Doppler radars worldwide. With full-scale production located alongside our development teams, we can explore new solutions together and continuously improve our products for customers.

Demand for our products is growing, and customer solutions are becoming increasingly complex. We are therefore looking for a new colleague who can strengthen the quality of our mechanical production documentation and support the continued development of our advanced radar systems.

Improve the quality of mechanical drawings and production documentation

Your primary responsibility will be to ensure a high-quality mechanical production basis, enabling efficient manufacturing and consistent product quality throughout the entire product lifecycle.

Your tasks will include:

• Ensure correct application of GPS (Geometrical Product Specifications) principles in mechanical drawings

• Review and improve drawings, tolerances, datums, fits, surface specifications, and edge requirements

• Support design engineers in creating robust and manufacturable production documentation

• Develop and maintain drawing standards, templates, guidelines, and best practices

• Participate in design reviews with a focus on manufacturability, inspection strategy, and drawing quality

• Work closely with production, quality, technical designers, and mechanical engineers to resolve drawing-related issues

• Contribute to continuous improvement of design processes, reviews, and development methods

• Support root-cause investigations related to dimensional or manufacturing challenges

Understand both drawings and design

The ideal candidate understands that a good drawing starts with a good design. Therefore, you are not only experienced within GPS and mechanical drawings but also capable of understanding and developing  the functional requirements of mechanical parts and assemblies.

Your professional background could include:

• A degree in Mechanical Engineering or similar

• Extensive experience with mechanical drawings and production documentation

• Strong knowledge of GPS standards, including ISO 1101, ISO 5459, ISO 14405, ISO 13715 and related standards

• Experience with machined metal parts and manufacturing processes

• Experience with CAD tools such as Autodesk Inventor and Autodesk Vault

• A solid understanding of mechanical design principles and product development

• Experience supporting production and quality organizations

• Strong communication skills

Your new team

In Weibel’s R&D department, you will join more than 280 highly skilled and dedicated colleagues. Our subgroup consists of 20 mechanical engineers with experience ranging from a few years to more than 30 years, working across a wide range of projects. We work closely with electronic engineers, hardware engineers, technical designers, production specialists and system architects because we believe the best solutions come from bringing different competencies together early in the design process. Designs are verified and developed through reviews, simulations and prototyping.

Contact and application

Please note that we review applications on an ongoing basis. Apply via our website using the “Apply” button. Applications may be submitted in Danish or English. If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Engineering Manager Søren Bay at sba@weibel.dk.

The application deadline is 25 October 2026, but we will begin the hiring process as soon as we receive the first application.

Please note that this position requires a criminal record with no remarks and the ability to obtain security clearance.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Bliv en del af en dansk virksomhed

Weibel Scientific A/S er en danskejet ingeniørvirksomhed i kraftig vækst. Vi udvikler og producerer højteknologiske radarer til brug i bl.a. rumforskning, flyindustri, forsvar samt beskyttelse af kritisk infrastruktur. Vi er verdensførende inden for udvikling af Doppler-radarer og har siden vores etablering i 1977 leveret flere end 4.500 state-of-the art radarer til mere end 40 lande.

Vores hovedkvarter ligger i Allerød og beskæftiger knap 600 medarbejdere.

I Weibel kan du se frem til et spændende og udfordrende job i en dynamisk og fremtidsorienteret virksomhed med in-house produktion og højteknologisk udvikling.

Læs også meget mere om os på vores hjemmeside.

Would you like to drive the commercial growth of a leading Danish technology company and strengthen the position of Weibel Scientifics XENTA radar portfolio across defense and critical infrastructure markets internationally?

At Weibel, you will join a truly technology-driven company that delivers Doppler Radars across the world. Weibel is recognized as a world leader in radar technology, with our radars performing with a precision largely unmatched by competitors. We are committed to delivering innovative solutions at the very forefront of radar technology.

Due to increasing demand for our systems, we have been growing rapidly over the last five years. With a team of more than 600 dedicated professionals, our growth story is one of strategic development, commercial excellence, and global expansion. As we continue to evolve, we remain committed to our mission of providing cutting-edge radar solutions that serve the needs of our customers and contribute to a safer world.

Our XENTA surveillance radar portfolio represents an important growth opportunity for Weibel across defense and critical infrastructure protection.

About the position

As Marketing Account Manager for Surveillance, you will play a key role in turning this growth potential into focused commercial action.

Working closely with the Surveillance Business Unit and Sales, you will help establish and drive our account marketing approach for XENTA across defense and critical infrastructure markets. You will help identify where to win, which accounts and stakeholders matter the most and how marketing can help create, influence and push commercial opportunities.

You will combine strategic judgement and commercial understanding with hands-on execution, building the account marketing function together with the Director of Marketing & Communication and Business Unit.

You will report to the Director of Marketing & Communications and join a newly established Marketing & Communications team with an ambitious agenda.

About you

You are an experienced commercial marketer who is comfortable operating at the intersection of business strategy, technology and marketing. You can set direction and work with senior commercial stakeholders while turning strategy into concrete action and activities.

You thrive in an environment with significant growth potential where not everything has been defined yet. You bring structure and focus, are curious enough to understand complex technology and markets, and how to translate insights into activities that have commercial impact.

Experience from defense, aerospace, security, critical infrastructure or other complex B2G and B2B environments is an advantage.

We expect that you will bring:

• Significant experience with account marketing, product marketing, GTM or similar commercially focused marketing roles.

• A strong commercial mindset and experience working closely with senior Sales and Business Development stakeholders.

• Experience developing account strategies and translating business priorities into focused marketing actions.

• The ability to understand complex technology and translate capabilities into clear customer and decision-maker value.

• Strong stakeholder management skills across seniority levels and functions.

• Experience developing sales enablement and customer-facing content such as use-cases, case stories etc.

• A relevant educational degree.

What we offer

• A central role in developing account marketing for one of Weibel’s key growth businesses.

• The opportunity to work with XENTA surveillance radar portfolio across growing defense and critical infrastructure markets.

• The opportunity to help build a function, not just inherit it.

• A position in a growing Danish technology company with significant international ambitions.

• A professionally challenging environment with advanced technology, global customers, great colleagues and a purpose that contributes to a safer world.

Contact and application

Please apply at our website using the ”Apply” button.

The deadline is the 2nd of November 2026.

Please note that this position requires a criminal record with no remarks and the ability to obtain security clearance.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Become part of a Danish company

Weibel Scientific A/S is a Danish-owned engineering company experiencing strong growth. We develop and manufacture high‑technology radar systems for use in areas such as space research, aviation, defense, and the protection of critical infrastructure. We are a world leader in the development of Doppler radars and, since our establishment in 1977, we have delivered more than 4,500 state‑of‑the‑art radar systems to over 40 countries.

Our headquarters are located in Allerød and employ nearly 600 people.

At Weibel, you can look forward to an exciting and challenging position in a dynamic and forward‑looking company with in‑house production and advanced technological development.

Read more about us on our website.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As Lead IT Auditor at SimCorp, you will be responsible for leading and executing IT audits to evaluate the effectiveness of internal controls, information security systems, and compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements. This role involves assessing IT infrastructure, systems, and processes to identify vulnerabilities and areas for improvement. The Lead / Principal IT Auditor works closely with business units and senior leadership to test whether IT risks are managed effectively, and that the organization’s technology systems support its compliance and operational objectives.

In an IT organization like SimCorp, the Lead / Principal IT Auditor promotes collaboration among business, information security, risk management, and Internal Audit. By conducting risk-based audits and identifying relevant issues, the auditor enhances IT governance, risk management, and business resilience, ensuring compliance with policies and industry standards while promoting continuous improvement and accountability

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Lead and execute IT audits across various business units to assess the effectiveness of internal controls and the security of IT systems and infrastructure

• Evaluate IT processes, applications, and systems for compliance with internal policies, regulatory standards, and industry best practices

• Identify and assess IT risks, vulnerabilities, and control gaps, providing actionable recommendations for mitigation and improvement

• Collaborate with IT teams and business units to ensure that audit findings are addressed and corrective actions are implemented effectively

• Prepare detailed audit reports documenting findings, recommendations, and action plans, and present these reports to senior leadership

• Monitor and track the implementation of corrective actions from prior audits to assess improvements implemented by the business and issues are resolved in a timely manner

• Ensure that audits are conducted in alignment with industry standards and regulatory requirements concerning audit of IT-related risks

• Assist in developing audit plans, schedules, and priorities, ensuring audits are conducted in line with organizational objectives

• Assist in developing and refining audit methodologies, tools, and processes to improve IT audit practices

• Stay current on emerging IT risks, regulatory changes, and audit standards to ensure that audit practices remain effective and relevant

• Provide guidance and support to junior auditors, supporting their development in IT auditing and auditing standards

**TYPE OF WORK THIS ROLE ENAGES WITH

**

• Leading IT audits to evaluate IT infrastructure, security, and compliance

• Identifying vulnerabilities and recommending improvements to strengthen IT controls and mitigate risks

• Collaborating with business and IT teams to address audit findings and validate the implemented corrective actions

**What We Value

**

• University degree in Computer Science, Information Security or similar relevant field

• 7+ years of professional experience of practical IT auditing

• Strong cross-domain IT knowledge, including network technology, operating systems, Information Security, SDLC, cloud (MS Azure)

• Solid knowledge of common IT and security standards such as CSA-CCM, ITIL, COBIT, BSI IT Grundschutz, NIST, CIS-18 and ISO/IEC 27000 series

• Relevant professional certification such as CISA, CISM, CISSP or CIA preferred

• High analytical skills, methodical know-how and conceptual understanding of complex matters

• Fluent English and effective interpersonal communication abilities

**Benefits

**Attractive salary is essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please click the “Apply” button to learn more about the vacancy and what SimCorp has to offer regarding salary, benefits, and perks. Please note only applications sent through our system will be processed. Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your CV in English as soon as possible.

If you are interested in being part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is a good match, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

By Joining our team, you will have the chance to become part of a thriving company comprising collaborative, curious, courageous, and capable employees Explore a multitude of exciting learning and development opportunities, supported by our unique learning guild Engage with highly skilled and supportive colleagues, each bringing their diverse backgrounds and perspectives Join a company that not only values but actively advocates for Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion, cultivating a truly inclusive and empowering environment.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide bеst-іn-clаss solutions to our clients.

**Do you want to lead highly skilled engineers working with Computer Vision and Machine Learning in products used across the world?

**At Dalux, we build software that makes the construction industry smarter and more efficient. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Development Manager to lead teams in our Reality Capture department working with Computer Vision and Machine Learning .

This is a role for someone who combines strong people leadership with solid technical credibility . You do not need to be hands-on in the code every day, but you do need the experience and judgment to lead specialist teams, challenge technical decisions, and help us hire outstanding talent in the field.

**The role

**As Development Manager, you will be responsible for leading and developing a group of specialists working with Computer Vision and spatial understanding of visual data across our Reality Capture products and platform, including building and scaling performance-critical systems in C++. You will work closely with technical leaders, product leaders, and other managers across Dalux Development.

This is not just a delivery role. You will help build a strong specialist environment where talented engineers can do their best work, grow in their careers, and create meaningful product impact.

At Dalux, Development Managers typically contribute across four areas:

**People leadership

**You will lead and support your team members in their professional growth, motivation, and performance. You will help create clarity, direction, and engagement in a specialist environment, and you will play an active part in attracting and hiring new colleagues.

**Team and engineering enablement

**You will help your teams succeed by improving ways of working, removing obstacles, and strengthening collaboration. In a specialist department, that also means creating the right conditions for deep technical work, knowledge sharing, and high engineering quality.

**Product and cross-functional collaboration

**You will work closely with Product Management, Design, and technical leaders to ensure that our Computer Vision and Machine Learning capabilities are translated into intuitive product features that allow users to navigate, understand, and act on real-world site data. You will help balance technical possibilities, product value, quality, and long-term sustainability.

**Organizational development and change

**As Dalux continues to grow, many of our leaders contribute beyond their own teams. You may take part in or drive initiatives related to tooling, engineering processes, quality, innovation, technical maturity, or organizational development.

**What We Are Looking For

**We are looking for a leader with a background in software development and relevant experience from Computer Vision or similar domains working with visual or spatial data .

Most importantly, you have the technical understanding and leadership maturity to lead highly skilled specialists and help them perform at a high level.

**We expect that you have:

**

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field

• Experience with development of Computer Vision systems

• Experience taking responsibility in either technical leadership , people leadership , or both

• A passion for helping other people grow and succeed

• Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical roles

**It is an advantage if you also have:

**

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or applied fields of Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Robotics, Autonomous systems, or similar

• Experience leading specialist teams or senior engineers

• Experience working with spatial data, mapping, or geometry-heavy problems in a product development context

• Experience hiring technical talent in highly specialized fields

• Experience working in empowered product teams or similar collaborative product development setups

**What Success Looks Like In The Role

**In this role, you will succeed by building a strong and healthy specialist engineering environment. That means:

• Your teams are motivated, growing, and delivering high-quality work

• Collaboration across engineering, product, and design is strong

• The department is able to attract and hire great specialist talent

• Technical depth and product impact reinforce each other

• You help scale both people and practices as Dalux grows

**Why join Dalux?

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005. We create digital tools for the construction industry, and our products are used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

We are proud to develop our products entirely in-house , and we care deeply about engineering quality, modern technology, and building strong teams. At Dalux, you will join an environment with ambitious colleagues, real product impact, and a strong belief that great software is built by empowered people working closely together.

This is an opportunity to take on a meaningful leadership role in a company that is growing fast, while helping shape how specialist engineering capabilities like Computer Vision and Machine Learning create value in real products.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc Position in Computational Materials Chemistry at the Mads Clausen Institute
Assistant Professor in Materials for Power Electronics / Printed Electronics
jobs.description:
The cross-border region Denmark-Germany is a powerhouse in industrial electronics. The Centre for Industrial Electronics (CIE) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) was established by a strong partnership between industry, academia and regional authorities. CIE is located at the campus of SDU Sønderborg and surrounded by a vibrant industrial environment. CIE is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Job description 

We are seeking an innovative and visionary Assistant Professor to join the Centre for Industrial Electronics in Sønderborg. The Centre currently has 40 staff, including full and associate professors, assistant professors, postdoctoral researchers, PhD students, and support staff. Funding has been secured to support to establish new research and test laboratories in key areas of industrial electronics. Our ambition is to deliver excellence in research, innovation, and education.

It is our vision that the Centre for Industrial Electronics at SDU will excel in areas of key relevance for companies in the region of Southern Denmark and beyond. 

Candidates are thus required to have a proven research records at least one of the following fields:

• 
General power electronics and its reliability

• 
Multimaterial additive manufacturing

• 
Printed electronics

• 
Polymer composites and nanocomposites for energy applications

• 
Surface and interface engineering

• 
Dielectric materials and capacitor technology

• 
Materials for power electronics

• 
Energy-device manufacturing

• 
Sustainable and circular electronics

 

Qualifications

The candidates must have a PhD in Electrical Engineering/Materials science/Mechanical engineering, or a closely related discipline. 

We also expect:

• 
An outstanding research and publication track record 

• 
Experience with industrial collaboration

• 
Research experience in multi-material additive manufacturing of functional polymer composites

• 
Experience developing polymer nanocomposite dielectrics and thin-film capacitors

• 
Knowledge of nanoparticle surface modification, dispersion, and interface engineering

• 
Hands-on experience in materials processing, device fabrication, and electrical characterization

• 
Ability to investigate relationships between material structure, manufacturing conditions, and electrical performance

• 
Peer-reviewed publications in functional materials, additive manufacturing, or energy-device research

• 
Experience collaborating across materials science and electrical engineering.

Further desirable qualifications:

• 
Experience with bio-based, self-healing, or temperature-resistant capacitor materials

• 
Knowledge of scalable thin-film fabrication, including layer-by-layer deposition or coating.

• 
Experience translating research into industrial applications, particularly embedded heating, sensing, or battery-conditioning systems.

• 
Experience preparing research proposals, securing research resources, and training students.

 

Contact and further information

For information about the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical engineering, which encompasses SDU Electrical Engineering please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/ime.

For specific information on section and centre, please visit www.sdu.dk/ee and www.sdu.dk/cie. 

You are also welcome to contact the Head of the CIE, Professor Thomas Ebel (ebel@sdu.dk,  +45 93 50 72 05) for further information. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

A panel will assess the qualification of the candidate for the described post based on the submitted material. 

The application should include:

• 
Curriculum Vitae.

• 
Motivated application. 

• 
Ideas for research and development activities.

• 
Account of significant contributions to innovation in Electrical Engineering and Industrial Engineering Electronics.

• 
Complete list of publications.

• 
Publications most relevant to the position. 

• 
Summary and documentation of teaching experience, including account of experience in training students and outreach. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio. 

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

• 
References/reference letters may also be included.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the position is open from start of 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.occupation: Senior Contract Management Specialist (Senior Contract Counsel)
jobs.description:
**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**The Senior Contract Management Specialist / Senior Contract Counsel (CM) is a key role in the Contract Management team, which is part of Legal & Compliance. The CM supports all SimCorp offerings, including on-premises, SaaS, Professional Services and BPaaS. The CM is responsible for drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and executing various contracts with clients, as well as providing legal advice and guidance on contract and commercial matters. The CM also ensures that the contracts are compliant with the law and the business objectives, and that SimCorp performs its obligations under the Contract Assurance & Performance framework.

The CM works closely with the Legal team, Customer Success Management, Service Delivery Management, Project Management Office, and other internal stakeholders to understand the business and technical requirements, and to align the contracts with the best practices and standards of SimCorp. The CM also collaborates with Client Services to monitor and optimize the commercial performance and quality of the contracts.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**The CM is involved in the entire contract lifecycle, from the pre-contractual phase and support to Customer Success Management, to the onboarding project, to the contract change management, to the obligation management and quality assurance, to the exit handling.

The CM also manages and maintains together with the team the contract repository and the contractual database and supports the further implementation of contract management processes and relevant tools within SimCorp, including the upcoming Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) Platform.

The CM will be part of a self-organizing and cross-functional team that delivers value to the clients and the business.

As a CM, some of the daily or weekly tasks that you can expect are:

• Drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and executing client contracts, and ensuring that they are aligned with the legal, commercial and technical requirements

• Business partnering through legal advice and guidance on contract and commercial matters, and resolving contract-related issues and disputes

• Supporting the Customer Success Management, the Service Delivery Managers, the Project Managers, and other internal stakeholders with contract and legal interpretations

• Monitoring and optimizing the commercial performance and quality of the contracts, and collaborating with the business on commercial management

• Supporting the obligation management and quality assurance process, and ensuring that SimCorp performs its obligations under the Contract Assurance & Performance framework

• Supporting the exit handling process, and assisting with drafting termination notices and handling contractual obligations related to the exit strategy

• Participating in weekly status meetings

• Learning and developing new skills and competencies related to contract management and legal matters

**What We Value

**

• A law degree or a relevant degree in contract management, contract administration, or business administration, with a focus on commercial law

• 5+ years of experience in contract management, contract administration, or as a legal counsel, preferably in the SaaS, Outsourcing or IT industry

• Knowledge of contract and commercial law, as well as the legal and regulatory aspects of SaaS and cloud services

• Knowledge of Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) is an advantage

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Co-Pilot/Claude, and in contract management software and tools

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken

• Experience working in a collaborative team that values teamwork, humor, and good communication

• The CM is expected to have solid communication and presentation skills, as well as solid analytical and problem-solving abilities. The CM should be able to work on their own initiative and as part of a team, and to handle multiple tasks and projects in a fast-paced and demanding environment. The CM should also have a high level of professionalism and integrity, and a customer-oriented and self-starter mindset

**Benefits

**Attractive salary is essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact MadhuraPangarkjar], Senior Talent Acquisition Partner at madhura.pangarkar@simcorp.com If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide bеst-іn-clаss solutions to our clients.

**What You Will Be Doing

**As our Security Incident Response Leader, you will lead a team that safeguards banking operations for millions of customers while adapting to cloud and advanced technologies. You will collaborate with technology, business, and risk stakeholders to maintain robust security across the Group.

• Lead and develop a technically skilled incident response and threat management team

• Play a central role in major incident management, leading investigations and making decisions in line with policy, legal requirements and tested processes

• Provide timely briefings to the Chief Security Officer on the status of technical controls, response capabilities and major investigations within your area

• Design and refine incident response processes, runbooks, and playbooks

• Oversee digital forensics to ensure investigations are legally defensible

• Support compliance activities including regulatory requests and audits

• Monitor key performance indicators for detection and containment times

• Foster team growth through mentoring and knowledge sharing

• Coordinate threat intelligence to support tactical and strategic functions

**About You

**

• Minimum 6 years professional experience in cyber security operations

• At least 4 years in daily threat monitoring and response activities

• Minimum 2 years people management or team leadership experience

• Strong understanding of enterprise technologies and security controls

• Ability to communicate clearly with technical and senior stakeholders

• Knowledge of IT risks, controls, and European financial regulations

• Industry certifications such as CISSP, GCIA, GCIH, OSCP, or equivalent

• Experience in financial services or regulated environments would be valuable, along with a master's degree in cyber security, computer science, or related field.
